0022600179.text: The Pelicans (3-4, on a three-game winning streak) host the Utah Jazz (1-6, on a five-game losing streak) in New Orleans, the Pelicans' eighth game of the season. New Orleans will be without Dejounte Murray (personal reasons), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain), and Yves Missi (knee bruise), while Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise). The teams have met once this season, with the Pelicans losing 120-119 in Salt Lake City on October 23, after they won all three meetings with Utah in the 2025-26 season.
